Dry Run makes no changes. Apply unlocks only after a Dry Run whose fingerprint
and asset contract match Phase 104 exactly.

One operation at a time. While Dry Run, Apply, Verify or Rollback is running,
every button is disabled and a concurrent request is refused outright - it is
never queued. Wait for the result before pressing anything.

If the panel above does not say "Hermes Phase 104 Visual System", you have the
wrong plugin loaded - remove it from Plugins > Development and re-import.
